verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online documents its own background automation: custom workflows (Advanced), automated payment reminders, Payroll AI that proactively collects time data, and user-built automatic transaction rules confirmed by a community user. These are narrow, single-purpose automations with thin documentation rather than a general autonomous automation builder. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose automation/workflow builder with configurable triggers and schedules, detail on how custom workflows run unattended, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-style autonomous execution.
